name: Chutes & Ladders (Declarative)
description: A turn-based race for 2 to 4 players. Spin to move along the numbered board, climb ladders, and slide down chutes.
rules: Move your token from the start toward square 100. Spin to move the indicated number of spaces; climb a ladder when you land at its base and slide down a chute when you land at its top. The first player to reach square 100 wins.
ui_instructions: Choose a token during setup, then tap Spin on your turn. The board shows each player's position and the ladders and chutes.

tutorial.text: Move your token from the start toward square 100. Spin to move the indicated number of spaces; climb a ladder when you land at its base and slide down a chute when you land at its top. The first player to reach square 100 wins.
tutorial.html:
How to play

Move your token from the start toward square 100. Spin to move the indicated number of spaces; climb a ladder when you land at its base and slide down a chute when you land at its top. The first player to reach square 100 wins.

Choose a token during setup, then tap Spin on your turn. The board shows each player's position and the ladders and chutes.

ar.game_logic_rules: حرّك قطعتك من البداية نحو المربع 100. أدر المؤشر للتحرك؛ اصعد إذا وصلت إلى أسفل سلم، وانزل إذا وصلت إلى أعلى منزلق. يفوز أول من يصل إلى المربع 100.
